name: Amine acid gas removal (MDEA, formulated amines)
principle: Sour gas is contacted with an aqueous amine solution in an absorber, which takes up CO2 and H2S. The rich solution is flashed, heated against lean solution and regenerated by steam stripping, releasing acid gas to a sulfur recovery unit or CO2 handling. MDEA-based formulations can be tuned for selective H2S removal for sales gas or deep CO2 removal for LNG.

process_steps.name: Acid gas disposal
equipment: sulfur recovery unit, CO2 compression for storage, or reinjection

performance.metric: CO2 content of feed gas to LNG pretreatment and after acid gas removal
performance.basis: NETL LNG model: removal from about 7,050 ppmv in pipeline feed to about 50 ppmv (low = outlet, high = inlet)

source.note: NETL, Life Cycle GHG Perspective on Exporting LNG from the United States: 2019 Update, DOE/NETL-2019/2041, 12 September 2019, Exhibits 5-7 and 5-11, Appendix B

advantages: Handles a wide range of CO2 and H2S levels
limitations: Solvent degradation, foaming and corrosion need management
Large columns are heavy for offshore and floating plants
